To fix this issue, the ADMX/ADML templates must be updated to the latest version, the setting removed from the GPO, and then added back in. If the CIS Microsoft Windows Server 2012 R2, Server 2016, or Server 2019 Benchmark is applied, LSA Protection is configured via a separate recommendation for those older versions of the Windows Server Operating System using the SecGuide.admx/adml template.
